notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Infrastructure arson spread
notable.line: Coordinated physical attacks expand from sabotage of fallback stores to arson against an unguarded data-centre construction site or municipal battery depot, forcing a national debate on protecting energy-transition infrastructure.

notable.title: Pool host refusal
notable.line: Municipal utilities quietly refuse to host guarded black-start pools after arson wave, forcing relocation of fallback stocks to military sites and eroding civilian cover.
